preconditions.description: The number of rows in the land plot is at least 3 and at most 300.
The number of columns in the land plot is at least 3 and at most 300.
The desired distance covering time is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
The time values for flat, ascent, and descent are each at least 1 and at most 100.

preconditions.expression: All heights are positive integers not exceeding 10^6.
preconditions.description: The heights of the squares are positive integers and each does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: The output should contain four positive integers representing the coordinates of the upper left and lower right corners of the chosen rectangle.
postconditions.description: The output must specify the coordinates of the rectangle that best fits the desired time t.

postconditions.expression: The rectangle must have sides of at least 3 squares.
postconditions.description: The chosen rectangle must have sides that are not less than 3 squares in both dimensions.

postconditions.expression: The rectangle must be completely contained within the land plot.
postconditions.description: The chosen rectangle must fit entirely within the given n x m grid of the land plot.

postconditions.expression: The time to traverse the rectangle must be as close as possible to t.
postconditions.description: The time to traverse the rectangle should be as close as possible to the desired time t, with the smallest possible difference.

invariants.expression: The rectangle must be a border of a rectangular area.
invariants.description: The chosen rectangle must be on the border of a rectangular area, meaning it must have at least one row or column that spans the entire width or height of the plot, respectively.

invariants.expression: The biathlete moves in a clockwise direction.
invariants.description: The biathlete will move in a clockwise direction around the chosen rectangle, starting from the upper left corner and moving to the right, down, left, and up respectively.
